name: Chives
description: Thin, hollow, grass-like leaves with a mild onion taste. Round purple flowers appear in early summer.

image.alt: Green chives with round purple flowers

quickFacts.label: Likes
quickFacts.value: Sun or part shade, moist soil

uses.title: Kitchen
uses.text: Bread and butter, eggs, potatoes and soups.

uses.title: Flowers
uses.text: The purple flowers are edible and look nice in salads.

growingTips.title: Light
growingTips.text: Sun or part shade both work.

growingTips.title: Water
growingTips.text: Keep the soil a little moist.

growingTips.title: Cutting
growingTips.text: Cut leaves about 3 cm above the ground; they grow back quickly.

growingTips.title: Dividing
growingTips.text: Every few years, dig up the clump and split it into smaller plants.
